sql: select 'dec' as k, (round(floor_strike)::bigint % 1000)::text as r, count(*)::bigint as n, count(distinct market_ticker)::bigint as m from crypto_ladder_snapshots where series='KXBTCD' and strike_type='greater' and captured_at >= '2026-11-03' and captured_at < '2026-11-04' and minutes_to_close between 20 and 40 and mid_cents between 15 and 85 group by 2 union all select 'spot', to_char(min(minute_ts),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), count(*)::bigint, extract(epoch from (max(minute_ts)-min(minute_ts)))::bigint/86400 from crypto_spot_candles where product='BTC-USD'
